preconditions.description: The number of names n is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 100 for name in names)
preconditions.description: Each name has a length between 1 and 100 inclusive.
All names contain only lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'Impossible' or a permutation of all lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout != 'Impossible' or not all(any(name1[i] > name2[i] for i in range(min(len(name1), len(name2))) if name1[i] != name2[i]) for name1, name2 in zip(names, names[1:]))
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'Impossible', the names are lexicographically sorted according to the new alphabet.
